name: Ruhia Matiu Wiripo
other_names: Ruhia Peri Matiu; Ruhia Paura Taitimu
notes: Second wife of Peri Paraihe; mother of Hone, Okena, Pirini and Arapeta Peri Paraihe (minute book 15 HK 261). The name suggests a daughter of Matiu Wiripo — which would make her a sister of Rihari Matiu, husband of her step-daughter Maraea — but that link is not stated on the record. First name reading uncertain. SUPPORTING EVIDENCE: in Paihia 1D1E2 (doc 1284640) her three sons Arapeta, Hone and Okena hold 5.317/5.318 each, exactly matching the 5.317/5.318 held by Rihari Matiu's children Hira, Rata and Rirena — the pattern of one Matiu Wiripo interest split between a daughter (Ruhia) and a son (Rihari), then among their children. Paihia 1D1C (doc 1488165): recorded as "Ruhia Peri Matiu" — sole successor in 1929 to three children who died young (Roi 1906, Hoana 1907, Hana 1909); alive in 1940. An annotation gives a further name, Ruhia Horomona / Paura Taitimu (reading uncertain), suggesting a later marriage to a Taitimu.
source: Māori Land Court records (Pātaka Whenua) — minute book 15 HK 261, 25 Sep 1936 (doc 1650181)

name: Atama Matiu
notes: Recorded as "Atama Matiu alias Okena Matiu" on the Paihia 1D1E succession schedule (doc 1488172); died 31 October 1941 (HK 24/168); trustee in 1940 for the minor successors of Pati Wharewaka. His 85.000 shares in Paihia 1D1E passed on 28 March 1952 to Toma, Mane, Takuira, Topia, Pateriki, Manuera and Iwa Atama and to the six Manihera grandchildren. Paihia 1D was Wiripo land (Pirini Wiripo → Matiu Wiripo, 1910), so Atama/Okena Matiu is very probably a son of Matiu Wiripo and a brother of Rihari Matiu — INFERRED, not stated on the record.
